newsitem.title: USA: News Corp in talks to buy PointCast - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: News Corp in talks to buy PointCast - WSJ.

text.p: News Corp is in talks to buy Internet broadcaster PointCast Inc, the Wall Street Journal said in its electronic edition on Tuesday.

Citing sources familiar with the deal, the paper said News Corp has offered between $350 million and $450 million cash for PointCast, which broadcasts information over Internet direct television to subscribers.
A deal would give News Corp a distribution channel for its different publications and media properties, the paper said.
California-based PointCast, a technology start-up venture, has plans to go public, the paper said.
